assets.name: vehicles
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: square atlas of 16 isolated hand-drawn children's workbook illustrations.
Create exactly one SQUARE image arranged as an exact 4 by 4 regular invisible grid: 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 objects total. The whole canvas is near-white. Each cell has identical 25% width and 25% height. Center the artwork in each cell. CRITICAL: the complete object including accessories must fit INSIDE the central 65% width and central 65% height of its cell, leaving at least 17.5% of that cell blank on every side. Keep all 16 illustrations visibly SMALL with generous blank margins; nothing may cross a cell boundary, be cropped, touch neighboring objects, or touch the canvas edge. Cell centers are at x/y 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. No visible grid lines.
Style/medium: warm friendly hand-drawn colored-pencil and crayon children's storybook art; muted honey yellow, warm red, sky blue, sage green, light tan, brown, soft gray; thin warm-brown outlines, round edges, slightly irregular pencil contours, dense soft crayon hatching with little white paper flecks. Match a traditional simple preschool object illustration sheet, not glossy vector graphics and not 3D. Shallow three-quarter view where useful; objects recognizable at small scale. Near-white clean paper background. No dramatic shadows.
No letters, words, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, people, hands, scenery, decorative filler, panel frames, or grid lines. This is only 16 isolated illustrations, not an explanatory diagram.
Exact cell order, read left to right and top to bottom:
Row 1: yellow bus; RED FIRE TRUCK with clear roof ladder; WHITE AND GREEN AMBULANCE with a small green medical plus symbol (no red cross); BLUE AND WHITE POLICE CAR with small blue roof beacon.
Row 2: green tractor with a very large rear wheel and small front wheel; yellow excavator with articulated arm and bucket; yellow bulldozer with broad front blade and tracks; mobile crane with long boom and hanging hook.
Row 3: airplane; helicopter with main rotor; large passenger SHIP with cabins and smokestack; small SAILBOAT with clear triangular sail.
Row 4: motorcycle with seat and engine; child's kick SCOOTER with upright handlebar, low foot deck, and two tiny wheels, absolutely no motor or seat; dump truck with tipping dump bed; yellow submarine with periscope.
Each is a clearly distinct vehicle, no duplicate shapes. Crane arm, ladder, rotors, sails, and all protrusions MUST remain inside the central 65% of the relevant cell.
